data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'layyinun' which means 'soft, gentle, tender'. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking images of delicate flowers and gentle breezes. The name Layyinun carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Layyinun usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the softness and gentleness of Allah's love and mercy.
data.etymology: Layyinun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Layyinun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
